description: FlowDa provides an open database of historical multiphase pipe-flow experiments with configurations, fluid systems and instrument information. The provider is SINTEF and IFE. Geographical and temporal coverage: SINTEF and IFE developed FlowDa under IMF3; coverage and resolution differ between experiments. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
